newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London down on futures nerves.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London down on futures nerves.

text.p: Japanese stocks fell slightly in quiet trading in London on Thursday, as traders were reluctant to stick their necks out on a deal ahead of Friday's futures and options settlement, sources said.
London's Nikkei ISE 50 index fell 4.97 points to 1443.60 by 1558 GMT. In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 closed down 67.18 points at 20,501.20.
"The futures settlements can provoke a big move," said one trader. "Nobody wants to put their hands up," he added.
Another trader said: "Nothing is being bid aggressively, and everything is being offered at close, or up one or two ticks,"

Traders said the market was jittery and had overreacted to speculation that Japanese institutions had lost their appetite for U.S. Treasuries. Markets were also quiet ahead of the Christmas break, traders said. "People just don't want to play," said one trader.
